settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content: Every piece is printed to order, just for you. Production usually takes a few business days, then it ships. You'll get tracking by email when it leaves.

settings.heading: Fit
settings.content: Tees and hoodies use unisex sizing: true to size for a classic fit, size up for the oversized look. Beanies are one size.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Don't iron the print. Do not prompt.
